title: Some uniform thickening of W ⊂⊂ U is still ⊂⊂ U (choice of ρ₀ and W̃ in the proof of 3.7)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^N = Euclidean N be open, and let W ⊆ ℝ^N satisfy W ⊂⊂ U, i.e. IsRelCompactOpenIn W U: W is open, closure W is compact and closure W ⊆ U. Then there is ρ₀ > 0 such that W̃ := thickening(ρ₀, W) = {z ∈ ℝ^N : infEdist(z, W) < ofReal ρ₀} also satisfies W̃ ⊂⊂ U: W̃ is open, closure W̃ is compact and closure W̃ ⊆ U.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclidean N)), IsOpen U → IsRelCompactOpenIn W U → ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ IsRelCompactOpenIn (thickening ρ₀ W) U
